business_purpose: Restore trusted ECS SSH access through an authenticated out-of-band Alibaba Cloud channel, then deploy only the validated V2 Home runtime commit for public human review while preserving the frozen V1 fallback.
raw_data_files: Authorized local 18-file Tmall set used only through a local browser file picker after deployment
decision_questions: What evidence-backed ECS condition closes SSH before authentication?
Does the minimum reversible recovery restore three consecutive BatchMode connections without weakening host security?
Does the exact validated commit deploy without changing legacy V1 or overstating visual acceptance?
validation_plan: Read-only out-of-band system, SSH, resource, firewall, and security-control diagnosis
Configuration backup before any edit, sshd -t before reload, and three rate-limited external BatchMode checks
Exact git-archive deployment with rollback point, remote build, PM2, Nginx, and port checks
Legacy V1 route regression plus public V2 Home real-data, restore, interaction, responsive, console, network, and screenshot checks
